description: This Java class models the <menu> XML element within the OFBiz framework, representing its structure, attributes, and rendering behavior. It is designed to be immutable and read-only, encapsulating menu-related data and providing methods for rendering and action execution.

classes.name: ModelMenu
classes.description: Represents an immutable model of a menu XML element, providing properties for attributes, menu items, actions, and methods for rendering and processing menu logic within the OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing the ModelWidgetVisitor interface to perform operations on this ModelMenu instance.

methods.name: addUpdateMenuItem
methods.description: Adds or updates a ModelMenuItem in the provided list and map, merging overrides if an item with the same name exists.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the list of actions associated with the menu.

methods.name: getBoundaryCommentName
methods.description: Returns a string used as a boundary comment name, combining menu location and name.

methods.name: getCurrentMenuName
methods.description: Returns the current menu name based on the provided context.

methods.name: getDefaultAlign
methods.description: Returns the default alignment setting.

methods.name: getDefaultAlignStyle
methods.description: Returns the default alignment style.

methods.name: getDefaultAssociatedContentId
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander for default associated content ID.

methods.name: getDefaultAssociatedContentId
methods.description: Expands and returns the default associated content ID based on context.

methods.name: getDefaultCellWidth
methods.description: Returns the default cell width.

methods.name: getDefaultDisabledTitleStyle
methods.description: Returns the default style for disabled titles.

methods.name: getDefaultEntityName
methods.description: Returns the default entity name.

methods.name: getDefaultHideIfSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the menu should hide if selected.

methods.name: getDefaultMenuItemName
methods.description: Returns the default menu item name.

methods.name: getDefaultPermissionEntityAction
methods.description: Returns the default permission entity action.

methods.name: getDefaultPermissionOperation
methods.description: Returns the default permission operation.

methods.name: getDefaultSelectedStyle
methods.description: Returns the default style for selected items.

methods.name: getDefaultTitleStyle
methods.description: Returns the default title style.

methods.name: getDefaultTooltipStyle
methods.description: Returns the default tooltip style.

methods.name: getDefaultWidgetStyle
methods.description: Returns the default widget style.

methods.name: getExtraIndex
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander for extra index.

methods.name: getExtraIndex
methods.description: Expands and returns the extra index string based on context.

methods.name: getFillStyle
methods.description: Returns the fill style.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the menu id.

methods.name: getMenuContainerStyle
methods.description: Expands and returns the menu container style based on context.

methods.name: getMenuContainerStyleExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander for the menu container style.

methods.name: getMenuItemList
methods.description: Returns the list of menu items.

methods.name: getMenuItemMap
methods.description: Returns the map of menu items by name.

methods.name: getMenuLocation
methods.description: Returns the menu location.

methods.name: getMenuWidth
methods.description: Returns the menu width.

methods.name: getModelMenuItemByName
methods.description: Retrieves a menu item by its name.

methods.name: getOrientation
methods.description: Returns the menu orientation.

methods.name: getParentMenu
methods.description: Returns the parent menu, if inheriting.

methods.name: getSelectedMenuItemContextFieldName
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleMapAccessor for the selected menu item context field.

methods.name: getSelectedMenuItemContextFieldName
methods.description: Based on context, returns the selected menu item name or default.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Returns the target attribute.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the expanded title string based on context.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title expander.

methods.name: getTooltip
methods.description: Returns the tooltip text.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the menu type.

methods.name: renderMenuString
methods.description: Renders the menu as a string with the specified renderer.

methods.name: renderSimpleMenuString
methods.description: Renders a simplified string representation of the menu.

methods.name: runActions
methods.description: Executes all sub-actions associated with this menu.
